[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 5-7 [[Bone]]s }} Skull Juju are dropped by the [[Gaki]] in the [[Echovald Forest]]. ==Acquisition== *[[Factions]] **[[Echovald Forest]] ***[[Pain Hungry Gaki]] ***[[Skill Hungry Gaki]] ***[[The Pain Eater (boss)|The Pain Eater]] ***[[The Scar Eater (boss)|The Scar Eater]] ***[[The Skill Eater (boss)|The Skill Eater]] ***[[The Time Eater (boss)|The Time Eater]] {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== *Enter [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)]] from [[Vasburg Armory]]: Non-boss groups with Stone Scale Kirin, Dragon Moss and Undergrowth seem to have about a 50% chance of having a gaki. Go immediately to the left (southeast) and kill the group there. Then move west to the center of the large open area in front of the Armory, clear several groups there, then move east to kill [[The Scar Eater (boss)|The Scar Eater]]. Look down below to the group south of the bridge; if there is no gaki there, leave it be. Move west through a group of Wardens, go over a small bridge and kill [[The Time Eater (boss)|The Time Eater]]. Map travel back to the Armory because trying to find more Gaki elsewhere in the zone is not time-efficient. ==Collectors== {{:Buk Dirayne/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|22nd August 2011 and 6th May 2013|The Eternal Grove (explorable area)|1 [[Skull Juju]]}} ==Notes== *The collector [[Buk Dirayne]] trades 3 Skull Jujus for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is over one and a half times more than just selling the trophies by themselves. [[Category:Profitable trophies]] [[Category:Items requested by Nicholas the Traveler]]
